items.title: Applications of the Principle of Superposition (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Applications of the Principle of Superposition: a main subheading of 7.2 Principle of superposition of waves, its own page (owner 2026-11-04); PDF 141-143.

blocks.text: Waves ki superposition ka principle istemal kar ke noise-cancelling headphones unwanted noise (bekaar shor) ko khatam kar dete hain, aur sunne ka experience zyada aaram wala (peaceful) ho jata hai.

items: Headphones mein ek ya zyada microphones hote hain jo ird gird ka shor (ambient noise) pakarte hain, jaise peeche logon ki baatein, engine ka shor ya mahaul ka koi bhi shor.
Microphone yeh sound signals headphones ke andar amplifier aur processing unit ko bhejta hai.
Processing unit ek "anti-noise" signal banata hai jo ird gird ke shor ka bilkul ulat hota hai (amplitude barabar, phase ulta).
Phir anti-noise signal headphones mein desired (chaha hua) audio (jaise music ya voice) ke saath chalaya jata hai.
Jab anti-noise signal ird gird ke shor se milta hai to dono waves ek doosre ko cancel (khatam) kar deti hain, aur sunne mein bohat khamoshi ho jati hai.

blocks.text: Yeh misal asal situation ko bohat saada kar ke batati hai, kyunke noise-cancelling headphones achhi cancellation ke liye complex (pecheeda) algorithms aur kai microphones istemal karte hain. Phir bhi un ka kaam samajhne ke liye superposition ka basic (bunyadi) principle hi asal cheez hai.

blocks.prompt: Superposition ka principle bayan kijiye aur us se noise-cancelling headphones ki wazahat kijiye (comprehensive question 7.1; MCQ 7.2). Jab do barabar waves bilkul ulat phase mein milein to result (nateeja) kya hai?
blocks.explanation: Jab do ya zyada waves ek hi waqt kisi particle par act karein to us ka displacement alag displacements ka algebraic sum (jama) hai, y = y1 + y2 + ... + yn. Headphones ird gird ka shor record karte hain, usi amplitude magar ulat phase ka anti-noise signal banate hain aur music ke saath chalate hain; jahan dono milte hain y = y1 - y2 = 0, to shor khatam ho jata hai aur music baqi rehta hai. Bilkul ulat phase mein do barabar waves ka result displacement sifar hai.

items: Superposition: resultant displacement = alag displacements ka algebraic sum.
Same phase: y = y₁ + y₂ (barabar hon to y = 2y₁); opposite phase: y = y₁ − y₂ (barabar hon to y = 0).
n waves: y = y₁ + y₂ + … + yₙ, ya y(x,t) = y₁(x,t) + … + yₙ(x,t).
Is se interference, beats aur stationary waves bante hain; noise-cancelling headphones anti-noise se shor cancel karte hain.
